how_to_apply: Report at 12:00 noon on 10 November 2026 at the Electronics & Communication Sciences Unit office, 9th Floor, S N Bose Bhavan.
Bring a signed application with the subject "Application for RA position for NQM Project", addressed to the Professor-in-Charge, Computer & Communication Sciences Division.
Bring a biodata in English with all the details the notice lists.
Bring originals and self-attested copies of all documents/testimonials.

content_sections.heading: ISI Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. PU/507/ADV/928 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ISI notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Ph.D. in Computer Science / Mathematics or related subjects (submitted / awarded), with a strong background in theoretical computer science research as evident from publications in top CS conferences/journals. Age limit: Maximum 50 years (as on 10 November 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/Women/Differently abled Usual relaxation as per Government of India norms, Exceptionally bright candidates with relevant research experience Age may be relaxed as per the recommendation of the committee Other conditions: Medical certificate of fitness from the Medical Officer of the Institute must be produced at the time of joining. Desirable: Research experience in theoretical CS in top institutes/universities

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ISI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates with a resume with incomplete information will be summarily rejected

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary appointment on a project. Initially up to at most 31 March 2027 from the date of joining the Institute. May be extended later or terminated earlier based on performance and availability of project funds. No claim to permanent employment with the Government of India or the Institute. No right to continuation under any other project after the present project ends.

content_sections.heading: How Will ISI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written/Programming test for shortlisting, if required Walk-in interview Document verification A written/programming test may be conducted, if required, to shortlist candidates for the interview. A merit list is prepared; the next candidate gets the offer if a selected candidate fails to produce documents and the medical certificate.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Signed application with the subject "Application for RA position for NQM Project" Biodata in English Aadhaar Card/Voter Card/PAN Card SC/ST/OBC/Differently abled status certificate, if applicable One passport size photograph, self-attested on the reverse side Originals and self-attested copies of all documents/testimonials

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ISI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Report at 12:00 noon on 10 November 2026 at the Electronics & Communication Sciences Unit office, 9th Floor, S N Bose Bhavan. Bring a signed application with the subject "Application for RA position for NQM Project", addressed to the Professor-in-Charge, Computer & Communication Sciences Division. Bring a biodata in English with all the details the notice lists. Bring originals and self-attested copies of all documents/testimonials. To appear online, email a resume and self-attested copies of all documents/testimonials to [email protected] before 9 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Fulfilling the essential qualification/experience does not guarantee selection. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining the post. The Institute reserves the right not to appoint any of the candidates.
